name: Steel Ribbon
tagline: The industrial-grade platform for company merch that actually gets worn.
positioning: Steel Ribbon is the swag operating system for owner-operators who refuse to hand out landfill. Design, warehouse, and ship branded goods from one console.

hero.h1: Swag that builds an empire, not a landfill.
hero.sub: Steel Ribbon gives small teams the merch machine of a Fortune 500: one console to design, stock, and dropship branded goods people actually keep.

features.title: One console, zero spreadsheets
features.description: Kill the reorder email chain. Track every hoodie, mug, and enamel pin across vendors from a single inventory ledger that never lies to you.

features.title: On-demand, no minimums
features.description: Order one shirt or ten thousand. We hold your blanks in our fulfillment nodes and print only when a recipient claims their gift.

features.title: Send links, not boxes
features.description: Drop a claim link in an email or Slack. Recipients pick size and color; we ship. No more guessing between S and XXL for 200 people.

features.title: Margins you can defend
features.description: Live landed-cost math on every SKU — blank, decoration, freight, and tax — so you quote client swag without torching your budget.

features.title: Sustainable by default
features.description: Every catalog item carries a materials passport. Filter to organic cotton, recycled poly, and FSC paper before a single unit prints.

features.title: Roles for your whole crew
features.description: Give the office manager ordering rights, the founder budget caps, and the client a read-only tracker. Per-seat, per-permission.

testimonials.quote: We used to run new-hire swag out of a coat closet and a shared spreadsheet. Steel Ribbon turned that into a claim link. Onboarding kits now ship themselves before day one.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramanathan

testimonials.quote: I sell branded merch to breweries, and margin is everything. The landed-cost view stopped me from underquoting a 4,000-koozie run that would have eaten my whole month.
testimonials.name: Devon Marsh

testimonials.quote: Our conference booth swag used to arrive late, wrong size, or not at all. This is the first platform that treats a startup's 60-unit order like it matters.
testimonials.name: Ana Castillo

pricing.blurb: For the solo operator running merch on the side of everything else.
For growing teams that ship swag on a real schedule.
For franchises and agencies running merch as a product line.

homepage.footerBlurb: Steel Ribbon is the swag operating system for owner-operators. Design once, warehouse everywhere, ship on demand — and never order 200 wrong-size shirts again.
